diagnostic_contract.schema_source: columns list inside the pinned dataset_manifest.json
diagnostic_contract.column_reconciliation: each decrypted part must match the manifest column list exactly, in order, before rows are processed
diagnostic_contract.required_timestamp_semantics: at least one of timestamp_utc or timestamp_ist must be in the schema; every present timestamp text field must match timestamp_epoch
diagnostic_contract.signature: every manifest column except the four explicitly approved collection-provenance fields when present
diagnostic_contract.reporting: aggregate counts, schema/signature hashes, conflicting field names; no raw keys, rows, identifiers, prices, features, labels, or decrypted tables

required_checks: Verify exact developer commit and all six source/test/workflow blob hashes
Verify exact tester R4 scope decision/report blobs and scope-only flags
Run the core module self-test and full core synthetic test suite on the pinned developer worktree
Run diagnostic self-test and diagnostic regression suite on the pinned developer worktree
Verify required manifest column checks, conditional UTC/IST schema semantics, ordered part-header equality, and missing/extra/reordered header rejection
Verify every actual manifest column is included in signature except the four permitted provenance variance fields
Verify seconds/milliseconds normalization, provenance-only duplicates, conflicting value detection including an unknown extra column, and row/part-order invariance
Static scan for network/source imports, plaintext/raw row output and any deduplication in the diagnostic
Verify artifact identity/hash checking occurs before manifest inspection and before encrypted-part iteration
Verify no real artifact is downloaded or decrypted during the review workflow
